details:
Dear VRChat Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I want to share an idea that I believe could significantly enhance the VRChat experience for both new and existing players.

Currently, creating custom avatars in VRChat can be a challenging process, requiring knowledge of Unity, the VRChat SDK, and avatar modeling software. While this approach allows for incredible creativity, it also creates a barrier for many players—especially those on standalone VR headsets like the Quest—who may not have access to a PC or the technical know-how to create avatars.

To address this, I propose the development of a streamlined in-game avatar creator that would allow players to create and customize their avatars directly within VRChat or through the VRChat website.

Key Features of the Avatar Creator

	1.	In-Game Avatar Customization:

	•	Provide base models (human, animal, fantasy, etc.) for players to modify.

	•	Include options to adjust body shape, facial features, hairstyles, clothing, and accessories.

	•	Allow players to add visual effects like banners, props, or simple shaders with easy-to-use tools.

	•	Enable real-time testing and adjustments while in-game.

	2.	Web-Based Avatar Creator:

	•	Create a VRChat website tool that allows players to design or edit avatars directly in their browser.

	•	Offer texture and color customization options.

	•	Include an easy export option to link the custom avatar to the player’s VRChat account.

Benefits

	•	Accessibility: This would empower players across all platforms—PC and standalone VR headsets—to create unique avatars without needing external tools or a powerful computer.

	•	Inclusivity: It would lower the barrier to entry for avatar creation, making customization an option for everyone, regardless of technical skill.

	•	Encouraging Creativity: More players would engage with avatar customization, enriching the VRChat community with diverse designs and creations.

	•	Streamlined Experience: Simplifies the process for new players and casual users who might otherwise find the current system daunting.

I genuinely believe that implementing such a feature would enhance the overall VRChat experience and attract even more players to the platform. It would also align with VRChat’s mission of fostering creativity and connection.

Thank you for taking the time to consider this idea. I’d love to hear your thoughts or answer any questions about the concept.
title: In-Game Avatar Creation
